fact.note: The source reads: “Lingít and Xaad Kíl into everyday life”.

fact.name: Xaad Kíl
fact.note: The source reads: “Lingít and Xaad Kíl into everyday life”. Haida language, spelled Xaad Kíl on the page; page names it together with Lingít.

fact.name: Anishinaabemowin

fact.name: Ojibwe

fact.name: Modoc
